commentary: With breadth severely impaired at 26 and the deterministic gate marked WEAK amid an eight-week market skid, Stan Weinstein's stage discipline and William O'Neil's market-direction rules dictate defensive posture. Three out of four individual stocks inevitably mirror general market indices; in sustained institutional distribution, breakout failure rates multiply. Mark Minervini's progressive exposure rule requires treating all new setups with strict pilot risk, taking only top-tier Stage 2 structures with confirmed relative strength and accelerating fundamentals. Unless broad accumulation emerges via an authentic follow-through day, capital preservation overrides opportunistic buying, demanding immediate stop discipline at predefined pivot invalidation levels.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Framework

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price holds above the 21-EMA, 50-DMA, and 200-DMA, testing neckline pivot resistance at 104.09. Aligned swing lows show compression on 2x volume, but overall relative strength remains subdued compared to true market leaders.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Latest Q1 FY27 revenue dropped 55% YoY to ₹46 Cr with net profit contracting 29%. Operating margins remain razor thin at 2-3%, and return ratios lag industry benchmarks. Fails core CANSLIM acceleration criteria.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Stop at 97.24. A break below base support invalidates pattern integrity; cut losses immediately without hesitation.

ADFFOODS.technical: SEPA breakout cleared 20-session high at 331.08 on 2.74x volume expansion. Price maintains alignment above rising 21-EMA, 50-DMA, and 200-DMA, with an unextended RSI of 56 indicating orderly momentum.
ADFFOODS.fundamental: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 25.9% YoY to ₹167 Cr driven by export demand, though PAT growth moderated to 13.4% due to elevated shipping costs. Low debt and ROCE over 20% remain healthy.
ADFFOODS.risk: Stop at 309.63. A violation of the breakout level exposes the position to broad-market drag; exit instantly.

AEGISLOG.technical: High-conviction power trend forming a 3-up continuation pattern off key moving averages. Clean alignment above rising 21-EMA, 50-DMA, and 200-DMA, displaying exceptional relative strength during Dalal Street's multi-week decline.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Spectacular Q1 FY27 earnings acceleration: net profit surged 211% YoY to ₹545 Cr on 37% revenue growth, lifted by terminal expansions and operating leverage. Robust balance sheet with zero promoter pledge.
AEGISLOG.risk: Stop at 1383.26. Close out exposure if price breaches the 21-EMA/50-DMA support pocket on heavy distribution.

ALICON.technical: Decisive 20-day high breakout above 870.67 supported by an institutional 10.48x volume expansion. Bullish moving average stack and MACD confirmed above zero line confirm renewed momentum.
ALICON.fundamental: Revenue hit a record ₹578 Cr (+38% YoY) with net profit rebounding 23% YoY. However, aluminum cost inflation compressed operating margins to 9.5%, keeping 3-year return on equity below CANSLIM thresholds.
ALICON.risk: Stop at 790.64. Heavy distribution below the entry trigger nullifies the high-volume thrust.

ARROWGREEN.technical: Constructive double bottom pressing the 953.70 neckline. Structure holds above all key moving averages with RSI 64 and tight inside-day contraction confirming supply absorption ahead of breakout.
ARROWGREEN.fundamental: Blockbuster Q1 FY27 turnaround saw revenue surge 116% YoY to ₹89.9 Cr and EPS expand 151% to ₹18.15. Operating margins reached 31%, backed by strong ROCE (~28%) and virtually zero debt.
ARROWGREEN.risk: Stop at 849.35. A breakdown below the right-side base low invalidates double-bottom structure.

ATLANTAELE.technical: Double bottom clearing neckline pressure at 1959.96 on 3.2x average volume. Strong bullish engulfing candle confirms accumulation off the 50-DMA support band within a wider Stage 2 advance.
ATLANTAELE.fundamental: Solid top-line execution in Q1 FY27 (+48% YoY) and net profit rising 50% to ₹47 Cr. Exceptional ROCE (>40%) and low debt, but YoY earnings momentum slowed sequentially from triple-digit rates.
ATLANTAELE.risk: Stop at 1804.62. Exit without hesitation if neckline breakout fails under adverse general market pressure.
